A '''laser scan emitter''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] module installed on the [[Hound-W2 SPD]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The module was fitted at the tip of one of the droid's four [[extensor arm]]s.<ref name="EGTD" />
